name: Does a Coinbase listing move a coin on Binance

history.reason: KILL (rejected with Luke's say-so, 2026-11-23): 72 events on 58 listing days, day 1 to 31 against the other coins mean -1.7%, P(< 0) 63%, 34% of placebo means as low; needed +-3% at 95% either way. The move comes before the listing (day -30 to 1: +25.6%, reported only), as the published studies found. Findings 27.
